checks.name: Two people receive independent form bindings and canonical answer stores for the same target
Unmapped responses receive independent review without changing requirement posture
Submission and review commands bind the acting identity and reject reviewer impersonation
External respondent identity stays separate from the authorized internal capturing actor
Response revisions retain submitted history and block current readiness until renewed acceptance
Program-basis drift and changed submitted sources cannot remain current accepted responses
Report population follows organizational scope and remains separate from current actor permissions
Accountability and history exports preserve person, capture, reviewer, cycle and source attribution
Legacy provenance never gains an invented respondent or independent acceptance in reporting
Captured response annexes and old report bodies stay unchanged after live source and identity changes
Response report routes render wired controls and Copilot preserves the displayed population
Response acceptance and contextual document acceptance remain independent decisions on the same pinned version
Legacy Evidence entries resolve to the same document version and response-linked review context
An eligible assigned program owner can accept a document without inventing a second reviewer
Approved vendor intake creates real named assignments and document requests without duplicating files
Legacy activation cannot bypass the vendor assignment and exact-document review gates
